description.value:
You fully embody heaven’s executioner, becoming the Archangel’s perfected vessel. While in your Avatar of the Archangel form, you gain the following benefits:

  • You shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for another 60 feet.
  • You have Resistance to all damage except Force.
  • When you hit a creature with an attack, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
  • You always know the direction and distance to any creature you have damaged since the start of this transformation. You can now expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of Avatar of the Archangel.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
